```{r plottingfunc}
plotsavepath <- paste0("//Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new_", whichpower, "power/rr_plots/bandplots", whichpower, "/")
dir.create(plotsavepath, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

plot_power <- function(emm_df, band, whichpower, whicheyes) {

  # Validate inputs
  band <- match.arg(band, c("Theta", "Alpha", "Beta"))
  whichpower <- match.arg(whichpower, c("absolute", "relative"))
  whicheyes <- match.arg(whicheyes, c("open", "close"))

  # Construct labels
  power_name <- if (whichpower == "absolute") "abspower" else "relpower"

  eyes_label <- if (whicheyes == "open") "eyes open" else "eyes closed"

  y_label <- paste(
    band, tools::toTitleCase(whichpower), "power, ", eyes_label
  )

  plot_filename <- paste0(
    "plot_", power_name, "_",
    tolower(band), "_",
    whicheyes, ".png"
  )

  # Calculate y-axis limits from confidence intervals
  y_min <- min(emm_df$lower.CL, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(emm_df$upper.CL, na.rm = TRUE)

  padding <- (y_max - y_min) * 0.05

  y_limits <- c(
    y_min - padding,
    y_max + padding
  )

  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(emm_df, aes(
    x = factor(TP),
    y = emmean,
    color = factor(Drug),
    group = Drug,
    linetype = factor(Drug),
    shape = factor(Drug)
  )) +

    # 95% model-adjusted confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +

    geom_point(size = 5) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("1" = "blue", "2" = "red"),
      labels = c("Oxytocin", "Placebo")
    ) +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("1" = "solid", "2" = "dotted"),
      labels = c("Oxytocin", "Placebo")
    ) +

    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("1" = 16, "2" = 15),
      labels = c("Oxytocin", "Placebo")
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(breaks = 1:6, labels = paste0("TP", 1:6)) +

    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +

    labs(
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = y_label,
      color = "Drug",
      linetype = "Drug",
      shape = "Drug"
    ) +

    #theme_classic(base_size = 20) +    
    
    #scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)) +
    

    #theme(
    #  axis.title = element_text(size = 24),
    #  axis.text = element_text(size = 24),
    #  legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    #  legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    #  legend.position = "none")
    
        theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
      
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 17),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 17)
    )

  # Save plot
  #ggsave(
  #  file.path(plotsavepath, plot_filename),
  #  plot = p,
  #  width = 6, #8
  #  height = 5, #6
  #  units = "in",
  #  dpi = 300
  #)

  return(p)
}

t <- lmer(Theta ~ Theta_base + TP * Drug + (1 | id),data = data_eo)
# Estimated marginal means
emm_t <- emmeans(t, ~ Drug * TP)
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm_t)
plot_power(emm_df, "Theta", "absolute", "open")
```

```{r eo-theta}

#THETA

t <- lmer(Theta ~ Theta_base + TP * Drug + (1 | id),data = data_eo)
print(t)
a <- anova(t, type = 3)
print(a)

emmeans(t, ~ Drug)

# Estimated marginal means
emm_t <- emmeans(t, ~ Drug * TP)

emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm_t)
emm_df

# Plot
#plot_power(emm_df, "Theta", "absolute", "open")

# Pairwise comparisons
pairs_t <- pairs(emm_t, by = "TP", adjust = "none")
print(pairs_t)

t_to_d(t = 0.926,df = 190)
t_to_d(t = 1.624,df = 190)
t_to_d(t = 0.478,df = 190)
t_to_d(t = 1.135,df = 190)
t_to_d(t = -0.404,df = 189)
t_to_d(t = -0.061,df = 189)

```
